results.title: India’s anaemia problem: an ambitious programme to combat it, but no data to measure it
results.content: Anaemia readings were omitted from the NFHS-6 and were taken instead in the SAMPADA survey. The problem is, data from SAMPADA is yet to be released, leaving the country battling a major public health concern with no numbers to show where, an in whom the problem lies

results.title: India loses nearly 4.3% of GDP due to corrosion. Here’s how to fix it.
results.content: In this episode of The Climate Economy, we talk to Ashim Sharma - Senior Partner & Group Head Business Performance Improvement Consulting at Nomura Research Institute to understand how the traditional “L1” (lowest cost bidder) procurement model, optional material standards, and lack of life-cycle cost evaluation pose a massive threat to India’s rapid infrastructure expansion. We take a look at the policy changes are needed for future infrastructure projects.
